meta.title: The Never Ending Interview – short (9:16)
meta.summary: One link of the Never Ending Interview as a vertical short: the question, the next band's answer with word captions and the new question that goes on.

concept.idea: One link of a Never Ending Interview chain: a band asks a question (the asker briefly), the next band answers – shortened to the punchline, with word captions – and asks its own question for the next band. The link comes from the same reconstructed chain as the episode.

references.note: MVP reference test, result C (from the same chain as the episode): doc/mvp/E2E_REFERENCE_TEST.md

briefing.question: Which link (or which festival material) – or should the agent choose the strongest answer of the chain?

material.label: The answer and the band's own new question
material.description: One link of the chain reconstructed from transcripts (capability nei-chain).

sections.title: The question
sections.purpose: The asker briefly with the question; band_card of the asker.
notes: Band card: ["MYLES KENNEDY", "alter bridge"], image box in the upper half; give a 9:16 crop of the face.

sections.title: The answer
sections.purpose: The answer full frame (no vertical_in_16x9) with word captions and the wordmark flash over the first caption line.

sections.title: The new question
sections.purpose: The band's own new question for the next band, complete.

sections.title: End
sections.purpose: animal_scream (sound) → logo_end (video and audio clip), optionally revealed by a chevron_wipe.

wordmark_flash.role: over the first caption line of the answer

chevron_wipe.role: into the logo end or around the band card

captions.note: word timings via the MCP tool get_word_timings → darkmind-agent captions-words; safe zones are kept by the blocks (captions 54–70 % H, top 15 % and bottom 20 % free)

music.note: the brand pack ships no music (T14)

rules.text: The link comes from the same reconstructed chain as the episode (capability nei-chain, transcripts only – never upload notes or metadata); choose it by the strength of the answer.
No interviewer: the asker's question on camera, the answer shortened to the punchline, the band's own new question – no read-out questions, prompts or hand-overs of the interviewer.
Quotes verbatim; misheard band names are corrected with the editor (quote and caption).
No lower third; names come from the band card. Not part of the format: sting, lower third, format and cliffhanger cards, endcard.
At most one emphasised word per caption group (words[].emphasis), part of the caption text review.

report: the reason for the chosen link
